value.description: Must be >= 0 for steps and sleep_duration_min (enforced here). Unknown is not represented as negative.

unit.description: May be omitted or null while a draft is awaiting clarification; required for confirmed metrics.

local_date.description: Calendar day of the metric; for steps, the day covered by the daily total, used for filtering and grouping independently of occurred_at. May be omitted or null in a draft; required for confirmed metrics.

local_time.description: Local wall time; null if unknown. Not required or used to select daily steps totals.
